name: Lam Vien Square
summary: Lam Vien Square is the free lakeside square on Tran Quoc Toang, beside Xuan Huong Lake. A portal table cited by secondary articles prints 07:00 to 22:00. Thirty minutes is a normal stroll. On 19 and 31 December 2026 the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism puts the flower-festival shows here at 20:00.
getThere: Walk from Xuan Huong Lake to Tran Quoc Toang
heroCaption: The flower hall and the lake at Lam Vien Square

notice.title: The festival show is two nights
notice.body: The ministry plan puts the opening at 20:00 on 19 December 2026 and the closing, with the New Year programme, at 20:00 on 31 December 2026. An ordinary evening is the square, not that show.

body: The square sits on Tran Quoc Toang where the lake edge opens into a paved stage. An ordinary visit is a 30-minute stroll. The hours 07:00 to 22:00 are the portal table cited in secondary articles. Entry is free.

In December 2026 the square is also the festival stage. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism sets the opening at 20:00 on 19 December 2026 and the closing, with the New Year programme, at 20:00 on 31 December 2026. Flower displays run about 18 December 2026 to 3 January 2027 around the lake. A show ticket is Check on arrival. Do not expect the opening on an ordinary Tuesday.

figures.caption: The square building by the lake
figures.alt: Building on Lam Vien Square beside Xuan Huong Lake

gettingThere: Walk from the Xuan Huong shore to Tran Quoc Toang. The square is on the lake. No fare is printed.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Walk along the shore to the square. It is the same waterside stroll.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: The square is free. Hours 07:00 to 22:00 come from a portal table cited in secondary articles. A 2026 visitor ticket for the festival show is Check on arrival.
